title: Data Gathering Operations
purpose: Standard procedure for selecting, configuring, and running data-gathering methods. Covers method selection, rate limiting, caching, error handling, and result grading to ensure consistent, high-quality data collection across all teams.

method_selection.title: Method Selection
method_selection.overview: Choose the right data-gathering method based on your quality and speed requirements.

hybrid.description: Combines multiple data sources for highest quality results. Recommended for production research and market analysis.
when_to_use: Quality is more important than speed
Research findings will drive investment decisions

openalex.description: Fast academic/publication search via OpenAlex API. Best for speed when academic sources suffice.
when_to_use: Academic or scientific data is the target
Initial broad surveys before deep dives

method_selection.decision_rule: Default to hybrid for quality. Use openalex only when speed is critical or academic sources are specifically needed.

rate_limiting.title: Rate Limiting
rate_limiting.overview: All data gathering must respect rate limits to avoid IP blocks and API bans.

steps.action: Check the API's documented rate limits before starting any batch operation
steps.example: OpenAlex: 100 requests/second for polite pool (with email in User-Agent)
Set minimum 100ms between requests for APIs without documented limits

steps.action: Use exponential backoff on 429 (Too Many Requests) responses
steps.example: Wait 1s, then 2s, then 4s, up to 60s max. Retry up to 5 times before failing.

steps.action: Log all rate limit events for post-operation review

caching.title: Caching with request_cache.py
caching.overview: Use the request cache to avoid redundant API calls and speed up repeat queries.

steps.action: Import and initialize the request cache before making API calls
steps.example: from storage.scripts.request_cache import RequestCache; cache = RequestCache()

steps.action: Check cache before making any external request
steps.example: cached = cache.get(url); if cached: return cached

steps.action: Store successful responses in cache with appropriate TTL
steps.example: cache.set(url, response_data, ttl=3600)  # 1 hour TTL for volatile data

steps.action: Use longer TTLs for stable data, shorter for volatile data

guidelines.static_reference: TTL 604800 (7 days) - reference material rarely changes

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.overview: Handle errors gracefully to avoid losing partial results and to enable recovery.

steps.action: Wrap all external API calls in try/except blocks

handle.ConnectionError: Retry with exponential backoff up to 3 times
handle.TimeoutError: Retry once with doubled timeout, then skip and log
handle.HTTPError 4xx: Log the error, do not retry (client-side issue)
handle.HTTPError 5xx: Retry with exponential backoff up to 3 times

steps.action: Save partial results after every batch of 10 queries
steps.example: Write intermediate results to a temp file: storage/coordination/teams/<team>/output/partial_results.json

steps.action: On complete failure, write an error report with what succeeded and what failed
Never let one failed query abort the entire operation. Use continue-on-error pattern.

result_grading.title: Result Grading with grade_research.py
result_grading.overview: Grade all gathered results for quality and relevance before using them in analysis.

steps.action: Run the grading script on completed research output
Review the grade distribution. Expect: A (top 10%), B (next 30%), C (next 40%), D/F (bottom 20%)
steps.threshold: Only use A and B graded results for decision-making. C results are supplementary only.

steps.action: If more than 50% of results grade C or below, re-run with different search terms or a different method
Include grade summary in team output file for downstream consumers

pre_gathering: Select method (hybrid for quality, openalex for speed)
Verify API keys and access are configured
during_gathering: Check cache hit rate (should be >0% for repeat topics)
Log any errors with full context
post_gathering: Verify grade distribution meets quality threshold
Write final results to team output directory
Report metrics: total queries, cache hits, errors, grade distribution
